profile.headline: Software Architect, Senior Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Architect / Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Project: Quotations and Order Intakes Support and Administration Application, a tool that allowed an efficiency improvement of sales processing and administration by over 40%.

o	Design and development of the entire machines’ selling process – from inquiries over quotations to order intakes – in a seamless and highly comprehensive way. Support of its conception providing ideas for better capture and use of statistical data.
o	Design and development of additional tools for easing sales negotiations, planning the salesman budget and depicting the business development at any time period.
o	Integration of the enterprise’s CRM system.
o	Import of machine price lists and invoice data and their integration into the selling and business control process.
o	Automated generation of quotation and order intake documents.

Technologies: Java/J2EE, JSP, Hibernate, Spring, Glassfish, Oracle, SQL, Eclipse, Maven. OS: Windows/Unix.

company.name: Sandvik Mining and Construction Central Europe GmbH

positions.title: Software Architect / Senior Software Developer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Project: Car leasing and loan financing software	 for GMAC Bank 

o	Application core design at architecture board
o	Overall internationalization concept (i18n)
o	Development of core components

Technologies: Java, J2EE, JSF, Hibernate, EJB, JPA, JBoss, DB2, Eclipse, Maven, Jenkins, Git, Visual Paradigm, Jira, Scrum. BS: Windows / Unix

positions.title: Software Architect / Senior Software Developer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Project: Car leasing and loan financing software for Targobank 

o	Elaboration of the safety concept of the application (Joint analysis with the customer + concept development).
o	Draft of audit log components as well as implementing.
Design and implementation of the (configurable) password strength-validation component.
o	Design and implementation of the (two-phase) password reset process.
o	Design and implementation of SSO authentication.
o	Optimization of the import / export framework.
o	Optimization of process framework (transaction management).
o	Implementation of numerous import / export interfaces.

Technologies: Java, J2EE, JUnit, SOAP, Hibernate, JAX-WS, JAXB, EJB, JPA, JTA, VT-Password, SSO, JBoss, DB2, Eclipse, Maven, Jenkins, Mantis.

positions.title: Software Architect / Senior Software Developer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Project: Car leasing and loan financing software for BMW Bank 

o	Creation of architecture guidelines and design documents for the implementation of quality requirements of product quality model from the ISO / IEC 25010 standard with emphasis in security.
o	Prototyping before the introduction of new technologies (XA transactions, Oracle RAC).
o	Design and Implementation of environment-spread the consolidation of all configuration files.
o	Implementation of the import / export interface.
o	Design and Implementation of Security Audit Trail framework.

Technologies: Java, J2EE, JUnit, SOAP, Hibernate, JAX-WS, JAXB, EJB, JPA, JTA, Glassfish, Oracle, DB2, Eclipse, Maven, Mantis, Scrum. OS: Windows

positions.title: Senior Software Developer (Consultant)
positions.description:
•	Project: PEP PDM, the BMW portal for managing / controlling all vehicle data (product development process, product management) 

o	Optimization of PDM release of EAI frameworks and direct access to SAP via JCO.
o	Extension of the JDBC framework for access to the (BMW-owned) PRISMA database to Oracle proprietary types and functions.
o	Optimization of PDM implementation of synchronous release mechanism in SAP (previously asynchronously).
o	Extension of the structures export function to SAP to support the English language.
o	Implementation of the interface to the system DUBAI.
o	Extension of the interface to the DMS.
o	Design and implementation of the refactoring of publication module.

Technologies: Java, J2EE, JUnit, JavaScript, ExtJS, JAXB, XML-RPC, DAO, SAP JCO, 
EA Weblogic, Oracle, Eclipse, Ant BS. OS: Windows

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Component's design and implementation of the tool ASCENT (Automotive Software CENTer), a BMW-border development platform for the ECU software development 
o	Requirements gathering for new features of the model kit logics, the core of ASCENT.
o	Creation of professional and technical concepts in consultation with all technical departments.
o	Implementation of various concepts in programming language JAVA (J2EE).
o	Addition of the test suite in the build server.
o	Analysis of field problems in their own software proportions of ASCENT as 3rd level support

positions.title: Project Manager (up to 9 developers), Software Architect  (Consultant)
positions.description:
Software product vt-designer (www.vt-designer.com), a tool for creating ISO 11783-compliant user interfaces for the control of agricultural implements 
o	Participation in the research process: identify customer needs, analysis of existing approaches and identification of future trends.
o	Requirements analysis and specification. Specification of the system architecture.
o	Design and specification of the main components and interfaces.
o	Planning and management of development (up to 9 programmers).
o	Support of test management, including design of the method for automated testing.
o	Support of customer support: User's Guide, workshops, 2nd and 3rd level support.

Technologies: C / C ++, wxWidgets, wxFormBuilder, XML, XSD, MS Visual C ++, KDevelop, CMake, Lint, ISOAgLib, Free Image, SVN, Bugzilla, Wiki, Redmine, Doxygen, PoEdit, UML, OOA, OOD, En-terprise Architect (EA), MS Visio, Trac, Open Project. OS: Windows, Linux.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer  (Consultant)
positions.description:
Design and implementation of the software product USSW, a universal PC service software for diagnosis, maintenance and software update of all types of fire and smoke detection systems (rail & aviation) of AOA. It's currentky used in over 40 rail companies in Europe and by AOA for the diagnosis of smoke detectors in Airbus A380 aircraft.

Technologies: Qt, C / C ++, CAN bus, PCAN-USB, Qt toolkit, QWT, XML, XSD, Dev C ++, KDevelop, NSIS, proprietary communication protocols of AOA and Airbus, OOA, OOD, CVS, Bugzilla, Doxygen, UML, MS Visio. OS: Windows, Linux.
